scripts.pretest: mkdir -p allure-results && rm -rf allure-results/backend allure-results/ai allure-results/integration allure-results/environment.properties allure-results/run.properties allure-results/.start_time && date +%s > allure-results/.start_time && node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomUUID())" > allure-results/run.properties
scripts.clean:backend: mkdir -p allure-results && rm -rf allure-results/backend allure-results/ai allure-results/integration allure-results/environment.properties allure-results/run.properties allure-results/.start_time
scripts.clean:ai: mkdir -p allure-results && rm -rf allure-results/backend allure-results/ai allure-results/integration allure-results/environment.properties allure-results/run.properties allure-results/.start_time
scripts.clean:security: mkdir -p allure-results && rm -rf allure-results/security allure-results/environment.properties allure-results/run.properties allure-results/.start_time
scripts.clean:integration: mkdir -p allure-results && rm -rf allure-results/backend allure-results/ai allure-results/integration allure-results/environment.properties allure-results/run.properties allure-results/.start_time
scripts.test:backend: npm run clean:backend && npm run init:run && node ../tests/allure-core/stability.js --precompute && bash -c 'cd ../backend && npm test; status=$?; node ../tests/allure-core/environment.js allure-results --suite backend; node ../tests/allure-core/stability.js; exit $status'
scripts.test:ai: npm run clean:ai && npm run init:run && bash -c 'pytest ../ai/tests --alluredir=allure-results/ai --cov=../ai --cov-report=json:allure-results/ai/coverage.json; status=$?; node ../tests/allure-core/environment.js allure-results --suite ai; exit $status'
scripts.test:security: npm run clean:security && npm run init:run && node ../tests/allure-core/stability.js --precompute && bash -c 'cd ../security && npm test; status=$?; node ../tests/allure-core/environment.js allure-results --suite security; node ../tests/allure-core/stability.js; exit $status'
scripts.test:integration: npm run clean:integration && npm run init:run && bash -c 'pytest integration --alluredir=allure-results/integration --cov=../ --cov-report=json:allure-results/integration/coverage.json; status=$?; node ../tests/allure-core/environment.js allure-results --suite integration; exit $status'
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:ai && npm run test:integration
scripts.postrun: node ../tests/allure-core/global-logs.js && cp categories.json allure-results/categories.json && cp known-issues.json allure-results/known-issues.json
scripts.pipeline: npm run stability:precompute && npm test && npm run stability:summary && node ../tests/allure-core/environment.js && node ../tests/allure-core/coverage.js && node ../tests/allure-core/executor.js && npm run postrun && npm run report
